findings.rule: Dependency rule — domain (vendor/shared) must not import infrastructure
findings.explanation: The shared contract imports ReportRunRow (a Drizzle $inferSelect row type) from modules/reports/repository.ts and embeds it in ReportDetailDto.latestRun. This points a domain-layer dependency outward at infrastructure, transitively drags drizzle-orm and db/schema types into vendor/shared (explicitly forbidden there), and hands a raw DB row shape to the HTTP wire — and because vendor/shared is mirrored into client/, it leaks server persistence internals (workspaceId, internal columns) across the package boundary. The same leak is what forces ReportDetailDto to be a plain interface instead of a Zod schema and makes buildDetail/toReportDetailDto pass runs[0] out unmapped.
findings.fix: Define latestRun in domain terms inside the contract (e.g. a reportRunSchema Zod object with only the fields the client needs) and extend reportSummarySchema with it; map ReportRunRow to that DTO in modules/reports/helpers.ts, and delete the repository import from vendor/shared.
